scenario.title: BATTLE OF BIALYSTOK-MINSK - 27 JUN 1941
intro.text:
BATTLE OF BIALYSTOK-MINSK - 27 JUN 1941

West of Minsk, Belarus

The treacherous Germans have launched a general attack on our homeland. The western front has collapsed and most of our troops are threatened to be encircled west of Minsk. Escape before the pocket closes! Make your way through the mess to the east!

ORDERS
Reach the Exit Points in time with at least 10 of your ground units before the enemy capture all VH!

NOTES
a. You can't deploy your air force.
b. All friendly auxiliary troops are controlled by the AI - you only command your core units.
c. Save your core units! Reach the Exit Points as soon as possible - don't get into a fight you can't win. There should also be useful attachments to make your units faster!
d. Attention - summer conditions! Don't forget to switch back to wheeled movement.

CORE (recommended)
2x Tank
4x Infantry
1x Anti-Tank
2x Reconnaissance
3x Artillery
2x Fighter Aircraft
1x Tactical Bomber
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-briliant.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.reaction-briliant.text: The Vyborg objectives were secured while the ceasefire messages were still being recopied. For once the military and political clocks struck in our favour.
line.reaction-victory.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.reaction-victory.text: We reached the western shore before the guns fell silent. Nobody agrees whether the last ground justified the last casualties.
line.reaction-tactical.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.reaction-tactical.text: The ceasefire found our bridgeheads barely established. The map changed in time; many units were still moving when the reason to move vanished.
line.callback-choice-a.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.callback-choice-a.text: At Vyborg you chose ground before the diplomats could stop the guns. The deadline rewarded you. This morning there is no negotiator waiting to make a lost road irrelevant.
line.callback-choice-b.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.callback-choice-b.text: You made every Vyborg crossing report guns and a return route before moving. That discipline preserved the force. Here the routes disappear faster than we can certify them.
line.scene-0.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.scene-0.text: The wireless net is a wall of callsigns speaking over one another. Some headquarters no longer answer. Others issue orders from positions the enemy passed yesterday. Only the roads east still provide a fact everyone can verify.
line.scene-1.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.scene-1.text: Front headquarters has sent forms for panic, desertion, and loss of command. I have left the names blank. Get the men through the corridor before someone asks me to fill them.
line.decision.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.decision.text: We can move the core at once and preserve the one formation we still control. Or we can hold one corridor open for stragglers and accept that every hour spent helping them narrows our own escape.
line.decision.choice.save-the-core.text: Break contact immediately and drive the core east before the roads are cut.
line.decision.choice.save-the-core.hint: Fully refuel the core and give tank and reconnaissance formations 20 experience for break-contact drills; no losses or ammunition are replaced.
line.decision.choice.hold-the-corridor.t: Keep one route open long enough to gather stragglers, then withdraw as a formed column.
line.decision.choice.hold-the-corridor.h: Gather an experienced seven-strength 1936 rifle detachment and restore the core to eight strength with full ammunition; the rescue effort costs 50 prestige.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.choice-a-0.text: No counterattack for appearances. Rear guards disengage on schedule, bridges are crossed in order, and any vehicle that blocks the road is pushed aside.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Pavel Antonov
line.choice-a-1.text: Those voices on the road are not all stragglers. Some are crews whose tanks were issued to units already overrun. Leave them and we save machines; wait and we may recover the men who know how to use them.
line.choice-a-2.speaker: Nikolai Orlov
line.choice-a-2.text: The late crews will find an empty road. I will not call them cowards to make our departure easier to explain.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.choice-b-0.text: The corridor gets a closing hour now, before sympathy turns it into a last stand. We leave with whoever reaches it in time and we do not move that hour twice.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Anna Sokolova
line.choice-b-1.text: I will put one closing hour on the wireless net. When it comes, Volkov moves the rear guard even if the last voice on the road is still calling.
line.post-0.speaker: Sergei Volkov
line.post-0.text: Survival is the mission. There will be time later to decide who failed; today we save the means to fight again.
